name: BSP_UnitInstance_UpdateTimers
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, float scaledDelta), RET 4, body 00956600..00956B3E, 372 instructions, no flow gaps, MSVC SEH frame 00CA8EE0. Second timed sub-update, called at 00825D6C. In order: f_524h += delta (unbounded); if (f_728h > 0) f_728h = max(f_728h - delta, 0); f_6D8h -= delta unconditionally. When f_6D8h goes negative and the descriptor at +354h holds a non-empty 16-byte-record vector ([+0Ch],[+10h]), f_6D8h reloads with 0.2f (00CE54A0) and the damage-threshold scan runs: hp = 00923BE0(this); only when hp < f_364h, each record with hp <= rec[0] < f_364h fires its anchor transform ([+354h]+28h indexed by rec[8], bounded by [+354h]+2Ch), its vtable +34h announce when rec[4] >= 0, and its effect template rec[0Ch]; f_364h = hp. Then the +70Ch animation chain (00956946..009569F6) and the fade at +2F4h toward +2F8h at 0.5/s (00D7A280), floored at 0 rising and clamped into [target,1] falling by 00415690. Tail pushes the visibility factor to the node at +4A4h through 00B6DA70; game mode 9 (004BCA50) makes it a hard 0/1 around 0.5f (00CE3800). docs/UNIT_TIMED_SUBUPDATES.md

name: BSP_Unit_OnDestroyed
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(Unit*), RET at 00959608. name: BSP_VehicleClass_IsEnemyOfLocalParty
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. docs/VEHICLE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.md. __fastcall(int classIndex). Returns byte[registry[4010h] + classIndex*3 + localParty] == 0, where localParty is *(*(00E188A8 + 18CCh + *(00E188A8+18ECh)*4) + 28h) and the whole routine short-circuits to a zero-extended value unless *(00E188A8+18ECh) is in [0,8). True therefore means the local player's party has NOT registered a need for this class, which is why 00964790 selects the enemy_ prefix (00D1A954) on true and own_ (00D1A94C) on false. It reads the bitmap 0095BA60 writes, and grows it through 004359E0 the same way.
